with open('/home/user/cloud-screen/main.py', 'r') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

SCRIPT_URL = 'https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbxUqsJwDBNyJ1GPp9rtaLn65lQDU16w4LzMtUcYgNrNdnJSfE5-TTBoP1pTzHIYNHSqBg/exec'

new_upload = '''def upload_clipboard():
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(['xclip', '-selection', 'clipboard', '-o'], capture_output=True, env=ENV, timeout=2)
        text = r.stdout.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').strip()
        if not text:
            text = '(剪贴板为空)'
        r2 = requests.post(SCRIPT_URL, json={'action': 'save_clip', 'text': text}, timeout=15)
        if r2.status_code == 200:
            print('剪贴板已上传 ✅ ' + str(len(text)) + ' 字节')
        else:
            print('剪贴板上传失败: ' + str(r2.status_code))
    except Exception as e:
        print('剪贴板错误: ' + str(e))
'''

new_check = '''def check_clipboard():
    global last_clipboard
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(['xclip', '-selection', 'clipboard', '-o'], capture_output=True, env=ENV, timeout=2)
        text = r.stdout.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').strip()
        if text and text != last_clipboard:
            last_clipboard = text
            try:
                r2 = requests.post(SCRIPT_URL, json={'action': 'save_clip', 'text': text}, timeout=15)
                if r2.status_code == 200:
                    print('剪贴板→AppsScript ✅ ' + str(len(text)) + '字节')
            except Exception as ex:
                print('剪贴板错误: ' + str(ex))
    except:
        pass
'''

content = ''.join(lines)
# 替换 upload_clipboard
import re
content = re.sub(r'def upload_clipboard\(\):.*?(?=\ndef )', new_upload, content, flags=re.DOTALL)
# 替换 check_clipboard
content = re.sub(r'def check_clipboard\(\):.*?(?=\ndef )', new_check, content, flags=re.DOTALL)

with open('/home/user/cloud-screen/main.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)
print('✅ 完成')
PYEOF
